en.headline: Animal activist charged after microchipped dog seized in Yuen Long hunt
en.dek: Kent Luk, founder of Paws Guardian Rescue Shelter, faces allegations of failing to control a dog and keeping an expired licence after an eight-dog sweep near a fatal suspected attack.
body: An animal welfare activist has been charged after one of the dogs seized in Yuen Long following a suspected fatal attack was found to carry a microchip registered in his name, according to multiple local news reports citing the Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department.

Kent Luk, founder of Paws Guardian Rescue Shelter, told reporters he had been accused of failing to keep a dog under proper control and of holding an expired dog licence. He said the 13-year-old village dog, known as Dai B, had been registered under his name after a 2018 rescue and sterilisation, then returned to an elderly scavenger who had long cared for the animal.

Police and the department have been conducting joint capture operations around Pok Wai South Road since a 27-year-old woman was found unconscious beside a bicycle on Sunday and later died. Officers have said they are investigating a suspected attack by a pack of dogs. A fourth-day sweep on Wednesday evening caught three more dogs, bringing the total held at an animal management centre to eight. At least three of the earlier five animals were microchipped.

The department has said captured dogs will be assessed and that DNA samples may be taken. Luk said Dai B was being held pending tests and that further charges could follow if the results linked the animal to the incident. The woman has not been named. No one has been accused of causing her death.

zh.headline: 元朗捕狗行動再獲三犬 動保義工被控疎於看管
zh.dek: 漁護署聯同警方第四日行動後累計扣留八隻唐狗；毛守救援創辦人陸家捷稱其名下晶片登記犬被控沒有妥善管控及過期狗牌。
body: 漁農自然護理署聯同警方繼續在元朗壩圍南路一帶捕捉無人看管狗隻，據本地傳媒引述，其中一隻已植入晶片的唐狗登記在動物組織「毛守救援」創辦人陸家捷名下，他已被控沒有妥善管控狗隻及過期狗牌兩罪。
陸家捷向傳媒表示，該犬名為「大B」，約13歲，2018年因受傷由他帶往愛護動物協會絕育，並以其名義登記晶片，其後交回一名長期照顧它的拾荒婆婆。他周三曾到新界北動物管理中心錄取口供。
一名27歲女子周日在壩圍南路被發現倒臥單車旁，其後不治，警方正調查是否遭多隻狗襲擊。漁護署表示，周三傍晚第四日聯合行動再捕獲三隻唐狗，累計八隻被送往動物管理中心扣留觀察，較早前五隻當中至少三隻有晶片。
署方表示會評估犬隻性情及健康，並可抽取樣本化驗。陸家捷稱「大B」正等候基因檢測，若結果顯示與事件有關，或會被加控其他罪名。死者身分未有公布，目前無人被指導致其死亡。
